existing_role_source: R01 semantics.py DEFINITIONS reported.* keys; SPECS remain unchanged
selection: Exactly one full caller-selector match within the supplied snapshot; zero and multiple matches reject. No latest, first-row fallback, de-duplication, restatement or completeness inference.

join.SEC: Same origin and exact request CIK, accession, form and filing date; explicit expected report date, acceptance metadata and primary document.
join.DART: Same origin and exact corp_code, request year/report/fs_div, receipt, account/statement/detail/ordinal/currency/period label and amount kind; exact expected filing date/name/corporation class/stock code.

runtime_guards: immutable JSON-only snapshot before schema parsing
DART raw-row and filing-payload reconstruction followed by original parsers and normalized DTO equality
every constituent receipt <= cutoff with exact fractional seconds
explicit caller timezone required and cutoff local date checked
selected filing/report dates checked against cutoff and relevant receipt calendar dates
SEC acceptance metadata never substituted for publication availability
canonical fact always null and semantic binding always false
persisted candidates fully reconstructed and compared including all hashes and caveats
remaining_gates: downstream canonical admission and metric computation
